description: ETS Bus Schedule GTFS Data Feed - Calendar Dates is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. To provide a list a dates when there will be changes to regular service in Edmonton. See for documentation. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Transit. Its tags are gtfs, ets, calendar dates, transit, bus schedule. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Edmonton. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
